JDub fell awkwardly, pinning his left leg underneath his body weight in a gruesome, terrifying lower-leg injury. You could hear a pin drop inside the Paycom Center as a towel was immediately thrown over his leg and medical staff rushed out with a stretcher. But the LAST moment is absolutely heartbreaking. As JDub was being stretchered off the floor, the entire arena broke into a standing ovation, chanting his name and letting out a chorus of the famous Thunder barks. Through absolute agony, Jalen Williams looked up and gave the home crowd two thumbs up.
